title: Everest Base Camp Trek
summary: The Everest Base Camp Trek is Nepal's most iconic trekking adventure, taking hikers through the heart of the Khumbu region to the foot of the world's highest mountain, Mount Everest (8,848.86 m). Along the way, trekkers experience breathtaking Himalayan landscapes, Sherpa culture, ancient monasteries, suspension bridges, and Sagarmatha National Park while acclimatizing through picturesque villages such as Namche Bazaar, Tengboche, Dingboche, and Lobuche. Reaching Everest Base Camp at 5,364 meters and hiking to Kala Patthar for panoramic sunrise views are the highlights of this unforgettable high-altitude journey, making it one of the world's most sought-after trekking experiences.

title: Everest Three Passes Trek
summary: The Everest Three Passes Trek is the ultimate trekking adventure in Nepal's Khumbu region, combining the classic Everest Base Camp route with crossings of the three high mountain passes—Kongma La (5,535 m), Cho La (5,420 m), and Renjo La (5,360 m). This demanding circuit offers spectacular views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, and countless other Himalayan peaks while visiting iconic destinations such as Namche Bazaar, Gokyo Lakes, Everest Base Camp, and Kala Patthar. With its challenging terrain, glacier crossings, and remote alpine landscapes, it is regarded as one of the finest high-altitude trekking experiences in the world.

title: Gokyo Lakes Trek
summary: The Gokyo Lakes Trek is a spectacular high-altitude journey through Nepal's Khumbu region, leading trekkers to the pristine turquoise lakes of Gokyo Valley and the panoramic summit of Gokyo Ri. The trek follows the Dudh Koshi Valley through traditional Sherpa villages, rhododendron forests, and alpine landscapes before reaching the sacred glacial lakes beneath some of the world's highest peaks. With breathtaking views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu, fewer crowds than the Everest Base Camp route, and the chance to explore the vast Ngozumpa Glacier, the Gokyo Lakes Trek is one of Nepal's most rewarding Himalayan adventures.

title: Gokyo Ri Trek
summary: The Gokyo Ri Trek is a scenic Himalayan adventure in Nepal's Khumbu region that takes trekkers to the summit of Gokyo Ri (5,357 m), one of the finest viewpoints in the Everest region. Passing through traditional Sherpa villages, alpine meadows, and the stunning Gokyo Lakes, the trail offers incredible panoramas of Mount Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, and the immense Ngozumpa Glacier. With fewer crowds than the Everest Base Camp route, this trek provides an excellent combination of breathtaking mountain scenery, rich Sherpa culture, and high-altitude trekking without the need to visit Everest Base Camp.

title: Cho La Pass Trek
summary: The Cho La Pass Trek is a thrilling high-altitude trek in Nepal's Everest region that connects the Gokyo Valley with the Everest Base Camp trail via the dramatic Cho La Pass (5,420 m). Trekkers journey through Sherpa villages, turquoise glacial lakes, rugged alpine terrain, and the vast Ngozumpa Glacier before crossing one of the Khumbu's most challenging mountain passes. Combining the beauty of Gokyo Lakes, Everest Base Camp, and Kala Patthar with an exciting alpine crossing, the trek offers an unforgettable adventure for experienced hikers seeking diverse landscapes and spectacular Himalayan views.

title: Renjo La Pass Trek
summary: The Renjo La Pass Trek is a breathtaking adventure in Nepal's Everest region that crosses the scenic Renjo La Pass (5,360 m), linking the Gokyo Valley with the remote Bhote Koshi Valley. The trek follows peaceful trails through traditional Sherpa villages, pristine alpine landscapes, and the stunning Gokyo Lakes before ascending to one of the finest viewpoints in the Khumbu. From the pass, trekkers are rewarded with panoramic views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, and countless surrounding peaks, making this a quieter yet equally rewarding alternative to the classic Everest Base Camp route.

title: Island Peak Climb
summary: The Island Peak Climb is Nepal's most popular trekking peak expedition, combining a classic Everest region trek with a rewarding non-technical mountaineering experience. After trekking through Sherpa villages and the spectacular Khumbu Valley, climbers establish a high camp before ascending Island Peak (Imja Tse) at 6,189 meters using crampons, fixed ropes, and basic alpine climbing techniques. The summit offers breathtaking views of Lhotse, Nuptse, Ama Dablam, Makalu, and the surrounding Himalayan giants, making it an ideal introduction to Himalayan mountaineering.

title: Lobuche East Peak Climb
summary: The Lobuche East Peak Climb is a challenging trekking peak expedition in Nepal's Everest region, offering experienced climbers an exciting blend of high-altitude trekking and technical mountaineering. Following the classic Everest Base Camp trail through Sherpa villages and Sagarmatha National Park, the climb culminates on Lobuche East (6,119 m), where climbers use crampons, ice axes, and fixed ropes to reach the summit. The reward is an unforgettable panorama of Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, Ama Dablam, Pumori, and the surrounding Himalayan peaks, making it one of Nepal's most sought-after alpine adventures.

title: Mera Peak Climb
summary: The Mera Peak Climb is Nepal's highest trekking peak expedition, taking climbers through the remote Hinku Valley to the summit of Mera Peak (6,476 m). The journey combines scenic trekking through pristine forests, alpine meadows, and traditional mountain villages with a gradual ascent to high-altitude glaciers before the final summit push. Although technically less demanding than many Himalayan peaks, the extreme altitude makes the climb physically challenging. From the summit, climbers enjoy one of the finest panoramas in the Himalayas, with views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, and Kanchenjunga.

title: Ama Dablam Base Camp Trek
summary: A scenic trek in the Khumbu region to the base of Ama Dablam (6,812 m), one of the most photogenic peaks in the Himalayas, passing through Namche Bazaar and Pangboche with close-up views of Everest, Lhotse, and Kantega.

title: Pikey Peak Trek
summary: A quieter alternative to the classic Everest treks, climbing to Pikey Peak (4,065 m) for a sweeping 360-degree panorama of Everest, Makalu, and the eastern Himalaya, through rhododendron forests and traditional Sherpa and Rai villages.

title: Khumbu Glacier Trek
summary: An exploratory trek along the Khumbu Glacier in the shadow of Everest, combining the classic base camp trail with close access to glacial moraines, ice formations, and high-altitude viewpoints above Gorak Shep.

title: Everest View Trek
summary: A short, gentler trek into the Khumbu that reaches Everest View Hotel above Namche Bazaar for panoramic sunrise views of Everest, Lhotse, and Ama Dablam, ideal for trekkers with limited time or acclimatization concerns.

title: Annapurna Circuit Trek
summary: One of the world's classic long-distance treks, circling the Annapurna massif through diverse landscapes from subtropical valleys to high alpine desert, crossing the dramatic Thorong La Pass (5,416 m) between Manang and Muktinath.

title: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
summary: A hugely popular trek into the Annapurna Sanctuary, a natural amphitheater surrounded by Annapurna I, Machhapuchhre, and Hiunchuli, passing through Gurung villages, rhododendron forests, and terraced hillsides.

title: Mardi Himal Trek
summary: A ridge-line trek off the beaten path offering close-up views of Machhapuchhre and the Annapurna range, climbing through forest and grassy ridgelines to a high viewpoint beneath Mardi Himal.

title: Khopra Ridge Trek
summary: A scenic and less-crowded trek to Khopra Ridge, offering wide views of Annapurna South, Dhaulagiri, and the Nilgiris, with an optional side trip to the sacred Khayer Lake.

title: Poon Hill Trek
summary: A short, iconic trek to the Poon Hill viewpoint (3,210 m), famous for sunrise panoramas over Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Machhapuchhre, through Gurung and Magar villages and rhododendron forest.

title: Mohare Danda Trek
summary: A community-run trek to Mohare Danda ridge, blending Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain views with homestays in Magar and Gurung villages, popular as a quieter alternative to Poon Hill.

title: Nar Phu Valley Trek
summary: A remote, restricted-area trek into the hidden valleys of Nar and Phu near the Tibetan border, featuring Tibetan-Buddhist culture, ancient monasteries, and dramatic canyon scenery, crossing the high Kang La Pass.

title: Tilicho Lake Trek
summary: A trek to Tilicho Lake, one of the highest lakes in the world, set beneath the Tilicho Peak with dramatic views across the Annapurna range, usually combined with the Annapurna Circuit.

title: Thorong La Pass Trek
summary: A high-altitude crossing of Thorong La (5,416 m), the highlight of the Annapurna Circuit, linking the arid Manang valley with the sacred pilgrimage site of Muktinath in Mustang.

title: Upper Mustang Trek
summary: A journey into the restricted former Kingdom of Lo, a high desert landscape of eroded cliffs, cave dwellings, and centuries-old Tibetan-Buddhist monasteries, centered on the walled capital of Lo Manthang.

title: Upper Mustang Jeep Tour
summary: A jeep-based journey through the dramatic desert landscapes and ancient monasteries of Upper Mustang, reaching Lo Manthang without the physical demands of trekking, ideal for travelers short on time.

title: Jomsom Muktinath Trek
summary: A classic trek through the dramatic Kali Gandaki gorge from Jomsom to the sacred pilgrimage site of Muktinath, passing apple orchards, windswept desert terrain, and traditional Thakali villages.

title: Muktinath Pilgrimage Trek
summary: A pilgrimage-focused trek to the sacred Muktinath Temple, revered by both Hindus and Buddhists, following the Kali Gandaki valley through Thakali villages and dramatic high-desert scenery.

title: Dhaulagiri Circuit Trek
summary: A demanding wilderness circuit around Dhaulagiri (8,167 m), crossing the glaciated French Pass and Dhampus Pass through remote high-altitude terrain, rewarding experienced trekkers with dramatic close-up mountain scenery.

title: Gurja Himal Trek
summary: A remote off-the-beaten-path trek to the base of Gurja Himal, offering solitude, untouched forest and alpine scenery, and dramatic views of the Dhaulagiri massif away from the main trekking routes.

title: Sikles Kapuche Trek
summary: A cultural trek through Sikles, one of the largest Gurung villages in Nepal, and onward toward Kapuche, combining traditional village life with forest trails and views of Annapurna II and Lamjung Himal.

title: Kapuche Lake Trek
summary: A trek to the glacial Kapuche Lake beneath Annapurna II and IV, a lesser-known destination combining forested trails, Gurung villages, and dramatic alpine scenery near Sikles.

title: Royal Trek
summary: A short, easy trek near Pokhara following the route once walked by Britain's Prince Charles, through Gurung villages and terraced farmland with fine views of the Annapurna range.

title: Machhapuchhre Model Trek
summary: A gentle introductory trek near Pokhara through Gurung villages with close views of the fishtail-shaped Machhapuchhre, well suited to families and first-time trekkers.

title: Lamjung Himal Trek
summary: A remote trek toward the base of Lamjung Himal, combining Gurung village culture with quiet forest trails and alpine terrain away from the crowded Annapurna routes.

title: Manaslu Circuit Trek
summary: A restricted-area circuit around Manaslu (8,163 m), the eighth-highest mountain in the world, crossing the high Larkya La Pass through remote villages, dramatic gorges, and diverse Tibetan-influenced culture.

title: Tsum Valley Trek
summary: A restricted, culturally rich trek into the hidden Tsum Valley, a sacred Buddhist enclave of ancient monasteries, chortens, and remote villages tucked beneath the Ganesh and Shringi Himal ranges.

title: Manaslu Tsum Valley Trek
summary: A combined trek linking the sacred Tsum Valley with the classic Manaslu Circuit, crossing Larkya La Pass after exploring remote Buddhist villages and monasteries beneath the Manaslu and Ganesh Himal ranges.

title: Rupina La Pass Trek
summary: A demanding and remote crossing of Rupina La, one of the toughest passes in the Manaslu region, traversing glaciated terrain and offering close views of Manaslu and Himalchuli.

title: Ganesh Himal Trek
summary: A remote wilderness trek around the Ganesh Himal range, combining forested trails, alpine pastures, and traditional Tamang villages with few other trekkers on the route.

title: Ruby Valley Trek
summary: A community-based trek through the Tamang villages of the Ruby Valley, known for its gemstone mining heritage, forested ridgelines, and views of Ganesh Himal and Langtang.

title: Langtang Valley Trek
summary: A scenic trek up the glacially carved Langtang Valley close to the Tibetan border, through Tamang villages, rhododendron forests, and yak pastures beneath Langtang Lirung.

title: Gosaikunda Trek
summary: A pilgrimage and trekking route to the sacred alpine lake of Gosaikunda, revered by Hindus and Buddhists, crossing rhododendron forests and high ridgelines in Langtang National Park.

title: Helambu Trek
summary: An accessible trek close to Kathmandu through the Sherpa and Hyolmo villages of Helambu, with terraced farmland, forest trails, and gentler altitude gains than most Himalayan treks.

title: Langtang Gosaikunda Trek
summary: A combined trek through the Langtang Valley and over to the sacred lakes of Gosaikunda, taking in glacier views, alpine forest, and high mountain passes in one extended route.

title: Tamang Heritage Trail
summary: A cultural trek through traditional Tamang villages on the edge of Langtang National Park, featuring hot springs, ancient monasteries, and views toward Tibet and the Langtang range.

title: Laurebina Pass Trek
summary: A high pass crossing linking Gosaikunda's sacred lakes with the Helambu region, traversing alpine ridgelines with wide views across Langtang and the Kathmandu valley rim.

title: Panch Pokhari Trek
summary: A remote trek to the sacred five lakes of Panch Pokhari, a Hindu pilgrimage site set on a high ridge with panoramic views of Langtang, Jugal Himal, and the eastern Himalaya.

title: Jugal Himal Trek
summary: A remote and rarely visited trek around the Jugal Himal range northeast of Kathmandu, offering solitude, traditional Tamang and Sherpa villages, and dramatic unspoiled mountain scenery.

title: Rolwaling Valley Trek
summary: A rugged trek up the remote Rolwaling Valley beneath Gauri Shankar, through glacial moraine and traditional Sherpa villages, popular with experienced trekkers seeking solitude.

title: Tashi Lapcha Pass Trek
summary: An extreme high-altitude crossing linking the Rolwaling and Khumbu valleys via the technical Tashi Lapcha Pass (5,755 m), involving glacier travel and requiring mountaineering experience.

title: Numbur Cheese Circuit Trek
summary: A community-based trek beneath Numbur Himal through Sherpa villages known for traditional cheese production, combining cultural immersion with quiet forest and alpine trails.

title: Sailung Trek
summary: A short and easy trek to Sailung Danda, a ridge known for its rhododendron forests, panoramic Himalayan views, and religious significance to both Hindus and Buddhists.

title: Pikey Sailung Trek
summary: A combined ridge trek linking the viewpoints of Pikey Peak and Sailung Danda, offering extended panoramas of Everest and the eastern Himalaya through Sherpa and Rai villages.

title: Kalinchowk Trek
summary: A short trek to the sacred Kalinchowk Bhagwati temple at high altitude, popular for its cable car access, panoramic mountain views, and winter snow scenery.

title: Kanchenjunga North Base Camp Trek
summary: A remote wilderness trek to the northern base camp of Kanchenjunga, the world's third-highest peak, through pristine forests, glaciers, and Tibetan-influenced villages in far eastern Nepal.

title: Kanchenjunga South Base Camp Trek
summary: A remote trek to the southern base camp of Kanchenjunga, offering close views of the massif and Jannu, through rhododendron forests and traditional Limbu and Sherpa villages.

title: Kanchenjunga Circuit Trek
summary: A demanding circuit linking both the north and south base camps of Kanchenjunga via high passes, offering the most complete exploration of this remote far-eastern wilderness.

title: Lumba Sumba Pass Trek
summary: A remote high-altitude crossing linking the Kanchenjunga and Makalu regions via Lumba Sumba Pass, traversing glaciated terrain rarely visited by trekkers.

title: Makalu Base Camp Trek
summary: A wilderness trek to the base of Makalu (8,485 m), the world's fifth-highest peak, through the pristine forests of Makalu Barun National Park and remote Sherpa and Rai settlements.

title: Makalu Circuit Trek
summary: An extended, demanding circuit around Makalu combining base camp views with remote high passes, glacier crossings, and rarely visited valleys in the Barun region.

title: Arun Valley Trek
summary: A lower-altitude trek following the Arun River valley through subtropical forest, terraced farmland, and diverse ethnic villages on the approach to the Makalu region.

title: Milke Danda Trek
summary: A ridge trek through some of Nepal's largest rhododendron forests between the Kanchenjunga and Makalu regions, with sweeping views across the eastern Himalaya.

title: Pathibhara Temple Trek
summary: A pilgrimage trek to the sacred Pathibhara Devi temple, one of Nepal's most revered Hindu and Kirat pilgrimage sites, set on a ridge with far-reaching Himalayan views.

title: Ilam Tea Garden Walk
summary: A relaxed walk through the rolling tea gardens of Ilam in Nepal's far east, combined with visits to Kirat and Nepali hill villages and views toward Kanchenjunga.

title: Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve Trek
summary: A trek through Nepal's only hunting reserve, a remote high-altitude valley of grasslands and forest home to blue sheep, on the western fringe of the Dhaulagiri range.

title: Rara Lake Trek
summary: A trek to Rara Lake, Nepal's largest and one of its most pristine lakes, set within Rara National Park in the remote far-western hills, known for turquoise water and quiet forest trails.

title: Rara to Jumla Trek
summary: An extended far-western trek connecting the pristine Rara Lake with the historic town of Jumla, through remote forests and traditional Khas villages.

title: Jumla Rara Horse Trail
summary: A unique horse-riding route between Jumla and Rara Lake in Nepal's remote far west, combining traditional Khas culture with untouched forest and lake scenery.

title: Sinja Valley Trek
summary: A culturally significant trek through the Sinja Valley, birthplace of the Khas kingdom and the Nepali language, combining historic sites with far-western hill scenery.

title: Phoksundo Lake Trek
summary: A trek to the stunning turquoise Phoksundo Lake in Shey Phoksundo National Park, Nepal's deepest lake, set beneath dramatic Trans-Himalayan cliffs in remote Dolpo.

title: Upper Dolpo Trek
summary: A restricted-area expedition into Upper Dolpo, a remote Trans-Himalayan region of Tibetan Buddhist culture, high desert plateaus, and ancient monasteries, made famous by 'Caravan' and Peter Matthiessen's writing.

title: Lower Dolpo Trek
summary: A demanding trek through Lower Dolpo's remote valleys and high passes, combining Phoksundo Lake with Tibetan Buddhist villages and dramatic Trans-Himalayan scenery.

title: Shey Gompa Trek
summary: A pilgrimage-style trek to the sacred Shey Gompa monastery beneath the Crystal Mountain in Upper Dolpo, a site of deep spiritual significance in Tibetan Buddhism.

title: Crystal Mountain Trek
summary: A remote trek in Upper Dolpo to Crystal Mountain, sacred to Tibetan Buddhists for its naturally occurring crystals, crossing high passes near Shey Gompa monastery.

title: Mugu Cultural Trek
summary: A cultural trek through the remote Mugu district, exploring traditional far-western villages, monasteries, and landscapes near the Tibetan border, off the standard trekking circuit.

title: Api Base Camp Trek
summary: A remote far-western trek to the base of Api Himal (7,132 m), Nepal's westernmost major peak, through untouched forest and traditional Byansi villages near the Tibetan and Indian borders.

title: Api Saipal Trek
summary: An extended far-western expedition linking the Api and Saipal Himal ranges, traversing remote, rarely trekked terrain near the tri-border region with India and Tibet.

title: Saipal Base Camp Trek
summary: A remote trek to the base of Saipal Himal (7,031 m) in Nepal's far west, offering solitude and untouched mountain scenery rarely visited by international trekkers.

title: Khaptad National Park Trek
summary: A gentle trek through the rolling grasslands, forests, and lakes of Khaptad National Park in the far west, home to diverse wildlife and the hermitage of Khaptad Baba.

title: Badimalika Trek
summary: A pilgrimage trek to the sacred Badimalika Temple, one of the most revered Hindu shakti peeth sites in far-western Nepal, set on a high remote ridge.

title: Ramaroshan Trek
summary: A remote trek through the Ramaroshan area of far-western Nepal, known for its high-altitude lakes, forests, and traditional villages rarely visited by outsiders.

title: Bajhang Cultural Trek
summary: A cultural exploration of the remote Bajhang district in far-western Nepal, visiting traditional villages, temples, and landscapes largely untouched by mainstream tourism.

title: Kailash View Trek Nepal
summary: A remote trek in far-western Nepal offering distant views toward Mount Kailash across the Tibetan border, combining pilgrimage significance with rugged high-altitude terrain.

title: Koshi Tappu Birding Tour
summary: A birdwatching tour through the wetlands of Koshi Tappu Wildlife Reserve, one of Nepal's premier birding destinations, home to hundreds of resident and migratory species along the Koshi River.

title: Chitwan Jungle Safari
summary: A wildlife safari through Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage lowland jungle home to one-horned rhinos, Bengal tigers, and diverse birdlife, with jeep, canoe, and walking safaris.

title: Bardia Jungle Safari
summary: A wildlife safari through Bardia National Park, Nepal's largest and wildest lowland park, known for tiger sightings, elephant herds, and a more remote, less-crowded safari experience than Chitwan.

title: Shivapuri Day Hike
summary: A popular day hike from Kathmandu into Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, climbing through forest to the summit of Shivapuri for views over the Kathmandu Valley and distant Himalaya.

title: Nagarkot Hiking Trail
summary: A short, popular hike near Kathmandu to the hill station of Nagarkot, renowned for sunrise and sunset views over a wide stretch of the eastern Himalaya, including Everest on clear days.

title: Chandragiri Hill Hike
summary: A hike (or cable car ascent) to Chandragiri Hill overlooking the Kathmandu Valley, combining a temple visit with panoramic mountain views close to the capital.

title: Phulchoki Hike
summary: A forested day hike to Phulchoki, the highest hill rim of the Kathmandu Valley, known for rich birdlife and springtime rhododendron blooms.

title: Jamacho Gumba Hike
summary: A short forest hike to the Jamacho Gumba monastery in Kathmandu's Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, offering peaceful trails and valley views close to the city.

title: Champadevi Hike
summary: A day hike to the Champadevi ridge on the southern rim of the Kathmandu Valley, popular for forest trails, valley views, and a religious shrine at the summit.

title: Nagarjun Forest Hike
summary: A short hike through the protected forest of Nagarjun (Jamacho) hill within Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, offering easy trails and valley views near Kathmandu.

title: Australian Camp Hike
summary: A short, easy hike near Pokhara to Australian Camp, a popular viewpoint ridge with wide views of the Annapurna range, well suited to families and beginners.

title: Sarangkot Sunrise Hike
summary: A classic short hike above Pokhara to Sarangkot viewpoint, famous for sunrise over the Annapurna and Machhapuchhre ranges and paragliding launch site.

title: Begnas Lake Hiking Trail
summary: A relaxed lakeside and forest hike around Begnas Lake near Pokhara, offering quiet trails, village scenery, and boating away from the busier Phewa Lake area.

title: Rupa Lake Hiking Trail
summary: A peaceful hiking route around Rupa Lake near Pokhara, combining lakeside trails, birdwatching, and village life away from the main tourist routes.

title: Ghalegaun Trek
summary: A short community-tourism trek to the Gurung village of Ghalegaun, known for traditional architecture, cultural homestays, and views of Annapurna, Manaslu, and Lamjung Himal.

title: Sirubari Village Trek
summary: A short, well-established community trek to Sirubari, Nepal's first model homestay village, offering an immersive introduction to Gurung culture and hospitality.

title: Ghandruk Village Trek
summary: A short, scenic trek to Ghandruk, one of the largest and most picturesque Gurung villages in the Annapurna region, with excellent close-up views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre.

title: Bandipur Heritage Walk
summary: A relaxed cultural walk through the well-preserved Newari hill town of Bandipur, combining heritage architecture, viewpoints, and short trails to nearby caves and villages.

title: Bhujung Village Trek
summary: A cultural trek to Bhujung, one of the largest Gurung villages in Nepal, offering traditional architecture, hospitality, and views toward Annapurna and Lamjung Himal.

title: Kori Himal Trek
summary: A quieter trek in the Lamjung foothills toward Kori Himal, combining forest trails and Gurung villages with views across the Annapurna and Manaslu ranges.

title: Poon Hill via Ghorepani Trek
summary: The classic route to Poon Hill through the picturesque village of Ghorepani, combining rhododendron forest trails with one of Nepal's most famous sunrise viewpoints over the Annapurna range.
